concerns.text: FR-001 (dynamic extraction & relevance profile aggregation) has no corresponding task in tasks.md; no task creates or validates the extraction pipeline or the RelevanceProfile JSON.
FR-002 (static index construction via K‑Means) is not linked to any task; while clustering tasks exist (T019‑T023), none are explicitly tagged to satisfy FR-002 or reference the StaticIndex contract.

FR-003 (static‑HiLS inference using the static index) lacks a dedicated task; T026‑T028 cover inference and evaluation but do not explicitly state modification of the HiLS pipeline to use the static lookup.
FR-004 (perplexity & QA evaluation) is not directly mapped to any task; evaluation tasks (T027‑T028) exist but are not tagged as fulfilling FR-004.
FR-005 (paired t‑test) has no explicit task; T029 performs a paired t‑test but is not linked to FR-005 via a tag or description.
FR-006 (latency reduction measurement) is not covered by any task; T030 measures latency but does not reference the required 2‑core CPU protocol or reduction factor.
FR-007 (downstream long‑context QA evaluation) is not explicitly addressed; T028 evaluates QA but does not cite FR-007 or the required QA dataset.
FR-008 (sensitivity sweep over K) is only partially covered by T031a/T031b; there is no task that ties the sweep results back to the FR‑008 requirement or produces the mandated trade‑off report.
SC-001 (perplexity difference measurement) is not linked to any task; no task records or validates the Δlog PPL metric.
SC-002 (latency reduction factor measurement) lacks a task that computes and records the reduction factor as defined.

SC-003 (statistical significance of perplexity difference) is not tied to a task; while T029 runs a paired t‑test, the requirement for reporting p < 0.05 and confidence interval is not explicitly captured.
SC-004 (QA accuracy comparison) is not associated with any task that records the accuracy difference between dynamic and static models.
SC-005 (memory‑footprint measurement via tracemalloc) is not linked to a task; T030b measures memory but does not reference SC‑005 or ensure isolation of the retrieval module.
SC-006 (sensitivity‑sweep trade‑off curves) is not covered by a task that generates the required sweep_report.json with per‑K metrics.
The SplitDefinition entity (validation/test split JSON) is defined in the data model but no task creates, validates, or stores this artifact.
Quickstart step for creating validation/test splits has no matching task; there is no task that runs the data_loader to produce filtered_pg19.json.
